subject: BrightLayer practice ops: launch & training plan
messages:
From: Devon Harris <devon.harris@brightlayer.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Wu <anna.wu@brightlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickstart: BrightLayer + Redwood practice launch

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our solutions team is excited about embedding Redwood into two pilot offerings. We want to kickoff a formal onboarding play to get our field practice trained and licensed before Q4. High-level asks: 

- A 2-week technical ramp (sandbox access + integration labs) for 6 engineers
- A 1-day enablement for the field (solutions briefing + sample playbooks)
- A short certification checklist we can use for internal readiness

Attached is a quick intake form with our expected timelines and product use cases. Can we target a start around the first week of August? Also please share any enablement material you typically use (playbooks, lab guides, recordings).

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick call to align dates.

Best,
Devon
Partnerships, BrightLayer Solutions
Attachments: BrightLayer_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Harris <devon.harris@brightlayer.com>, Anna Wu <anna.wu@brightlayer.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: BrightLayer + Redwood practice launch

Hi Devon / Anna,

Great to hear — excited to run this with your team. I've attached our latest Solution Catalog and an integration diagram that maps typical SI wiring for the two pilot patterns you mentioned. Quick responses to your asks: 

- Technical ramp: we can provision sandbox access and schedule 3 hands-on lab sessions across 2 weeks. Suggested dates: Aug 2, Aug 5, Aug 9 (all 90-min sessions).
- Field enablement: 1-day remote workshop delivered by our Partner Enablement team; agenda includes solution brief, security checklist, and two breakouts for sales vs engineering.
- Certification: we maintain a short checklist + a lightweight practical eval (30-minute guided lab). I'll share the checklist after we align resources.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Confirm headcount and preferred timezone for the labs (we assume PDT).
2) I'll loop in Karthik to coordinate the technical lab content and Rishi for certification criteria.
3) We'll create a shared Drive folder and publish the calendar invites.

Attaching: Redwood_Solution_Catalog_v2.pdf, integration-diagram.png.

Would you be available for 30 minutes tomorrow to confirm headcount and call out any compliance notes (Anna)?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Solution_Catalog_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); integration-diagram.png (image, 48KB)
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Kickstart: BrightLayer + Redwood practice launch

Team — forwarding BrightLayer ask. Please see intake and my proposed plan below. TL;DR: 2-week tech ramp for 6 engineers + 1-day field enablement.

What I need from you: 
- Karthik: draft lab exercises and an architecture deep-dive slot. Focus: prefix caching, routing policies, and quickstart for private deployment patterns. Estimate 3 sessions, 75-90 mins each.
- Rishi: produce a 6-step certification checklist and one practical eval (we can reuse an abbreviated lab from the lab exercises).
- Naomi: help with field enablement deck and two breakout tracks (sales play & implementation play). Also coordinate the workshop scheduling.

Constraints / notes from intake: BrightLayer indicated SOC2 evidence will be requested by their procurement. Anna (cc'd on original) will confirm which controls they require — expect questions on audit logs and data separation.

Action items: 
- Karthik: please reply with proposed lab topics + who from infra should join as SME by EOD Wed (Jul 21).
- Rishi: share a draft checklist by Thu (Jul 22).
- Naomi: propose a workshop agenda and two breakout leads by Fri (Jul 23).

I'll create the Drive folder and add our templates. Copying in the BrightLayer thread when we have dates.

Thanks — Olga
From: Anna Wu <anna.wu@brightlayer.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Harris <devon.harris@brightlayer.com>, partnerships <partnerships@brightlayer.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickstart: BrightLayer + Redwood practice launch

Hi Olga and team,

Thanks for the quick response and the materials — the catalog looks helpful. Confirming the following from our side: 

- Headcount: 6 engineers for the technical ramp (PST timezone)
- Preferred lab windows: Aug 2 (AM), Aug 5 (PM), Aug 9 (AM) — those map well to your proposed slots.
- Field enablement: target Aug 12 for the 1-day workshop.
- Procurement: I'll start our SOC2 evidence request and expect to send a short questionnaire next week. We do need explicit audit-log retention details and encryption-at-rest specifics.

Two asks before we lock calendar invites: 
1) Can you share a sample lab guide (step-by-step) so our engineers can validate prerequisites?
2) Please provide a 45-minute slot on the field workshop for our go-to-market leads to review co-sell positioning and value props.

If we can get the sample lab guide and a draft agenda by Fri (Jul 23), we can lock the dates. Sending a Teams invite shortly for a 30-minute alignment tomorrow morning (10:00 AM PST).

Best regards,
Anna Wu
Head of Solutions, BrightLayer Solutions
Attachments: none
